bundle.shortDescription: SignBit Fountain — air-gapped Bitcoin multisig signer
bundle.longDescription: SignBit Fountain is the offline signer for SignBit collaborative custody. Holds your keys on your device, generates them to the vault's descriptor spec, and signs PSBTs and policy approvals without ever touching a network.
